summary:
## Standing operator rules
Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Goal for this session: replace the hand-rolled retry loop in ledgerly/sync/client.py with tenacity.

Any new secret reference in config/secrets.yaml must use vault://ledgerly/<ENV>/<KEY> and never an environment-variable placeholder.

Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.

We tried wrapping the webhook handlers in a retry decorator with 5 attempts; it re-sent customer emails multiple times. Ruled out.

Sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; use sbx-pay-c, not shut-down sbx-pay-a or stale fixtures.

Stop the tenacity refactor, we will revisit it next sprint. New priority: the nightly reconciliation job in ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py is double-counting refunds; fix that.

## Recent work
Webhook cutover steps 2–5 completed; next run `kubectl -n payments logs job/webhook-replay-a`, then continue steps 6–8 in order without modifying commands. Worker tests pass (118 passed, 7 skipped). Deduplicated CLI billing flags; CLI/command tests pass (37). `ruff check ledgerly/cli.py tests/test_cli.py` found E501 at lines 117 and 203. Refund double-counting remains the priority.
